name: Jeunes Promesse Quebec
eligibilitySummary: Quebec provincial program supporting young entrepreneurs under 39 to start or acquire a business. Provides financial assistance and mentoring for youth-led business projects across all sectors.

funding.description: Non-repayable grants from $5,000 to $25,000 for business startup or acquisition costs. Additional mentoring and business support services provided through local CLDs.

application.applicationRequirements: Applicant must be under 39 years old, a Quebec resident, and hold at least 50% ownership of the business. Must submit a viable business plan and demonstrate need for financial assistance.
